# Coastal Pediatric Dentistry

> Board-certified pediatric dental practice in San Luis Obispo providing comprehensive dental care for infants, toddlers, and children using advanced technology and family-centered approach.

Coastal Pediatric Dentistry is led by Dr. James Forester and Dr. Natalie Vander Kam, both board-certified pediatric dentists serving the Central Coast of California. The practice specializes in preventive care, early intervention, and innovative orthodontic solutions like the Healthy Start System for children from infancy through adolescence.

## Services & Age-Specific Care

- [Our Services](https://www.coastalpediatricdentistry.net/our-services.html): Comprehensive pediatric dental services including emergency care and sedation
- [Who We Help](https://www.coastalpediatricdentistry.net/who-we-help.html): Overview of age-specific pediatric dental services for infants to children
- [Dentistry for Infants](https://www.coastalpediatricdentistry.net/dentistry-for-infants.html): Infant dentistry services including teething guidance and frenectomy
- [Dentistry for Toddlers](https://www.coastalpediatricdentistry.net/dentistry-for-toddlers.html): Toddler dentistry services including checkups, sealants, and cavity treatment
- [Dentistry for Children](https://www.coastalpediatricdentistry.net/dentistry-for-children.html): Children's preventive dentistry services and cavity prevention strategies
- [Preventive Dentistry](https://www.coastalpediatricdentistry.net/preventive-dentistry.html): Preventive dentistry and oral risk assessment for children in San Luis Obispo
- [Dental Checkups and Cleanings](https://www.coastalpediatricdentistry.net/dental-checkups-and-cleanings.html): Dental checkup and cleaning procedures for children's preventive care
